_doc: Layer per top-level src unit (lower number = lower layer; runtime imports go to the same or a lower layer, `import type` is exempt). L0 base (kb, git, platform, fleet = machine identity/types/placement primitives), L1 domain + L1p policy data (commands), L2 infrastructure, L3 CLI. `pure` units import nothing outside themselves at runtime. Upward imports that exist today live in layers.baseline.json, empty since U3.
